_about: The Sanctuary quote pill (roadmap Phase 1.5). One contemplative line on the Today panel, the same line all day, changing at midnight.
_editing: HAND-EDITED, NOT GENERATED. This set was seeded once from books.json and then curated; nothing regenerates it. Add, cut or reword freely - just keep every entry attributable, and keep text short enough to read in one breath.
_selection: Every line is drawn from a book already in the FRQNCY corpus, so the teaching lives on the site (editorial value 2) and the pill can link to its source. Chosen to open rather than instruct: prescriptive manifestation lines were deliberately left out, as were fragments that need their surrounding page to make sense, and anything that ranks people.
_consumer: Pick deterministically from the day, e.g. index = dayOfYear % quotes.length - same line all day, no randomness, no per-user state. topics[] carries the source book’s topic slugs so the set can later be filtered to what a person actually reads; until then, draw from the whole set.

quotes.text: You cannot find yourself by going into the past. You find yourself by coming into the present.
Meditation is not evasion; it is a serene encounter with reality.
Love says: 'I am everything'. Wisdom says: 'I am nothing'. Between the two my life flows.
We inhabit time as fish live in water. Our being is being in time.
quotes.attribution: The Order of Time — Carlo Rovelli

quotes.text: A feeling that is not resisted will disappear as the energy behind it dissipates.
quotes.attribution: Letting Go: The Pathway of Surrender — David R. Hawkins

quotes.text: Feelings are just feelings. They're not facts and they're not you, and you can let them go.
Spirituality unites; religiosity divides.
quotes.attribution: The Eye of the I, Chapter 12: The Search for Truth

quotes.text: All the great beings say, come into the realm of your heart.
quotes.attribution: My Lord Loves a Pure Heart — Gurumayi Chidvilasananda

quotes.text: Know satisfaction and you shall not be imperiled; then you will long endure.
Laughter and irony are at heart reminders that we are not prisoners in this world, but voyagers through it.
The kind of attention we bring to bear on the world changes the nature of the world we attend to.
quotes.attribution: The Master and His Emissary — Iain McGilchrist

quotes.text: Thought defends its basic assumptions against evidence that they may be wrong.
Most people do not listen with the intent to understand; they listen with the intent to reply.
quotes.attribution: The 7 Habits of Highly Effective People — Stephen R. Covey

quotes.text: The clearest way to see through a culture is to attend to its tools for conversation.
quotes.attribution: Amusing Ourselves to Death — Neil Postman

quotes.text: Don't be satisfied with stories, how things have gone with others. Unfold your own myth.
To thine own self be true, and it must follow, as the night the day, thou canst not then be false to any man.
We don't get what we want in life — we get what we need in order to grow.
If you want a new outcome, you will have to break the habit of being yourself, and reinvent a new self.
quotes.attribution: Breaking the Habit of Being Yourself — Joe Dispenza

quotes.text: What is easy is sustainable. Birds coast when they can.
A library doesn't need windows. A library is a window.
It’s not a building; it’s not an institution, even. It is relationships between one person and the next.
At the core of all anger is a need that is not being fulfilled.
In love we are swept off our feet; in trauma our legs are knocked out from under us.
For every action there is an equal and opposite reaction. You receive from the world what you give to the world.
quotes.attribution: The Seat of the Soul — Gary Zukav

quotes.text: Your true worth is determined by how much more you give in value than you take in payment.
I define super rich as the state of needing nothing.
We must constantly be learning, earning, and returning.
Success comes about by refusal to compromise integrity for the sake of anything.
quotes.attribution: Success Is For You — David R. Hawkins

quotes.text: The question of what you want to own is actually the question of how you want to live your life.
quotes.attribution: The Life-Changing Magic of Tidying Up — Marie Kondo

quotes.text: I'm going to die tonight. What would be the best thing to do with the rest of my time?
quotes.attribution: The Diamond Cutter — Geshe Michael Roach

quotes.text: Everything manufactured comes with a cost that exceeds its price.
quotes.attribution: The Responsible Company — Yvon Chouinard & Vincent Stanley

quotes.text: Stretch your body, and you stretch your mind.
quotes.attribution: The Shaolin Workout — Shi Yan Ming

quotes.text: Recipes don't make food taste good. People do.
quotes.attribution: Salt, Fat, Acid, Heat — Samin Nosrat

quotes.text: The greatest gift that you were ever given was the gift of your imagination.
Imagination and faith are the secrets of creation.
Once we begin to look for what's right, our lives begin spinning in unimaginably exciting new directions.
A change of feeling is a change of destiny.
quotes.attribution: Feeling Is the Secret — Law and Its Operation

quotes.text: What you exhibit outwardly, you are inwardly. You are the product of your own thought.
quotes.attribution: The Magic of Believing — Claude M. Bristol
